addressed_requirements: Aligned the order of hypotheses with the order of the results (and discussion) sections: the response says the hypotheses were reordered to match the results & discussion sections, which meets the reviewer's stated option that either section could be re-organized.
Gave a reason for the chosen approach: the response calls the matched ordering the most logical reporting structure.
Went slightly beyond the request by reordering the presentation of the measures to follow the new hypothesis order, which supports the alignment.
remaining_gaps: The response does not say whether cross-references between the pre-registered hypotheses and the results were added, but the reviewer offered this only as an alternative ("or at least cross-referenced"), so it is not required.

The response does not say whether the original pre-registered order is documented or noted, which would help readers compare against the pre-registration. The reviewer did not ask for this explicitly.
The response gives no section or line locations for the changes. Whether the reordering was actually carried out cannot be checked from the response text alone.

evidence_refs.exact_quote: Either section could be re-organized but it would help the reader if they were aligned or at least cross-referenced.
We have now reordered our hypotheses to match the ordering of the results & discussion sections, as we believe this to be the most logical reporting structure.
We have also altered the order in which we present the measures to more closely reflect the new ordering of the hypotheses.

answer.rationale: The reviewer's core concern is that the hypotheses and the results follow different orders. The reviewer explicitly allows either section to be reorganized and treats cross-referencing as a fallback. The response directly says the hypotheses were reordered to match the results & discussion, which resolves the mismatch and gives a brief reason. It also adjusts the order of the measures for consistency. It is not very specific, since it gives no locations and does not mention cross-references or the pre-registered order, but these were not required by the comment. At the text level the response adequately addresses the concern. This label rests on the response's wording only, and the actual revision is not verified.
